Figure 7:Human review interface for the Scissors instance.
Annotators inspect the input static SVG, generated animation with frame controls, and motion edit prompt before choosing match, non-match, or cannot judge.
For a rejection, they identify unsatisfied prompt text and describe the observed violation.
They can reveal the source Lottie animation, labeled “Reference animation,” only to clarify the prompt as one valid realization.
